Best for

  • Bedrooms, living rooms and offices where the AC runs for many hours a day
  • Homes that want lower electricity bills and a steadier room temperature
  • Rooms from about 100 to 250 sq ft (1.0 to 2.0 ton, depending on sun and occupancy)

How to choose

  • Size it to the room: around 1.0 ton for a small bedroom, 1.5 ton for a typical living room, 2.0 ton for large or sun-facing rooms.
  • Most current Hitachi inverter models are listed as stabiliser-free; we check your supply voltage at the site survey.
  • Every listed model has Hitachi's Tropical Inverter or Expandable Inverter technology; models such as the Kashikoi 5400X, Merai 3300S and Takeshi 5100X add the iSense activity sensor, and the 3100S series covers the essentials at a lower price.
  • Jodhpur summers regularly cross 45°C, so tell us if the outdoor unit will sit on a hot roof or west-facing wall.

Questions about Hitachi Inverter Split ACs

What is the price of a Hitachi inverter split AC in Jodhpur?

Prices depend on the series, tonnage and current offers, and change through the season. Call or WhatsApp Yamini Enterprises for today's price, including installation.

Which Hitachi inverter AC is best for a bedroom?

For a typical bedroom of about 120 to 150 sq ft, a 1.0 ton inverter split is usually enough; choose 1.5 ton for a larger or sun-facing room. We can recommend the exact model after a quick site check.

Do you install the inverter AC?

Yes. Our technicians handle installation, copper piping, drainage, electrical connections, testing and a demo, and we provide maintenance and repairs afterwards.
